Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.

FeatureName: Add subcontracting suggestions to an existing purchase order
Description: You can add new subcontracting worksheet suggestions to a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor, keeping related work on one order.
GettingStartedSteps: Use a company with the Premium experience and Microsoft's Subcontracting app installed and set up. Start with a released production order that has an outstanding operation at a subcontractor work center.
Open Subcontracting Worksheets and choose Calculate Subcontracts to get a suggestion for that operation.
On the New suggestion, choose Assign purchase order and select a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor. Note the order number.
Select Accept Action Message for that suggestion only, then choose Carry Out Action Message.
Open the purchase order you selected to see the new line for the subcontracted operation.
